answer_preview:
Answer:
The addition of the raw OCR nomenclature extractor changed the pipeline by enabling the recovery and improvement of description evidence in cases where visual or table records alone lack a clean nomenclature field. While the earlier `visual_figure_link` route can establish a link between a figure and a part number (e.g., Figure 69 to 120-50645-005 [V6]), this visual-link evidence alone should not be treated as clean nomenclature proof unless a source-trace-ready nomenclature field or OCR/table record supports it. The `ocr_nomenclature` route provides specific line-text evidence for the part name (e.g., "DOUBLE PASSENGER SEAT ASSY" [O1, O2]), and the nomenclature merger can carry this OCR-backed name into the visual evidence pack to complete the description.

Evidence:
- [V6, V7, V8] Visual evidence (`visual_figure_link`) establishes the identity between a figure number and a part number (e.g., Figure 69 is linked to 120-50645-005 [V6]).
- [O1, O2, O3] The OCR nomenclature route
